inputs.96.text: Full-length documentary photograph, standing straight and facing the camera in a relaxed three-quarter view, head to boots in frame, against a plain warm-grey studio wall under soft even daylight. A young white Union soldier of the American Civil War, about nineteen, of Irish-American descent, fair pale skin with ruddy freckled cheeks, sandy light-brown hair, pale blue eyes, a narrow face with a long straight nose and a slightly crooked mouth, a navy-blue kepi cap and navy-blue wool sack coat with brass buttons, light-blue trousers, worn brogans.
